style_rules.typography: Original sentence-led editorial layout; Source Serif 4 italic supports the identity line.
style_rules.highlight: Yellow-green emphasis #D9ED76 on dark ink or behind dark availability text.
style_rules.manifesto: Dark #242721 with paper headings and muted text #C4CBB8.
style_rules.spacing: 1280px content maximum; desktop gutter 4.5vw capped at 80px; phone gutter 22px.
style_rules.composition: Sticky numbered section margins and index; thin rules, flat surfaces and no repeated framed card grid on home.
style_rules.previews: 160ms fade, below navigation, no pointer hit targets. Reduced-motion users retain static inline evidence.
style_rules.motion: Existing 500ms hero reveal and 300ms entrance fades retained; all information stays visible without JavaScript.
